verdictRationale: All 6 cases: generatedWindowCount === theoreticalWindowCount (full 1..5 lattice emit).
blockedWindowCount === 0 for all fail cases — no hard-block pruning of critical windows.
Critical repair atoms have plain-key windows that exist and are recallable (e.g. 小食←消失 xiao|shi, 触发←出发 chu|fa, 阈值←阈之 yu|zhi, 我们←我闷 wo|men).
windowText===correctSurface generally absent because ASR Raw glyphs differ — expected, not a Window Builder bug.
Probe CSV charPinyinMatchesStream=false on polyphones (调 tiao vs diao) is isolated-vs-contextual comparison false positive; stream uses run-level textToSyllables.
Side note (non-blocking for these cases): normalizeSyllable strips ü so 率→l; still 1:1 char/syllable index.
q1_detail: ASR Raw → buildUtteranceSyllableCoordinate → textToSyllables(CJK run). Fail-case critical spans are 1 char : 1 syllable. Syllables are NOT derived from expectedText.
q2_correct_window_text: Glyph windows (windowText===正确词) generally DO NOT exist (Raw≠Expected glyphs). Homophone plain-key windows DO exist for all critical atoms.
q3_pruned: No windows hard-blocked in these 6 cases (blocked=0). Lattice filter reasons exist in contract but did not fire. No TopK/Beam at window generation.
q4_window_or_tone: FAILURE IS NOT MISSING WINDOW. Critical plain-key windows exist. Prior Query Builder audit shows Mode C tone key mismatch (e.g. xiao1|shi1 vs xiao3|shi2).

sideNotes.normalizeSyllableUmlaut: 率 → stream syllable 'l' because normalizeSyllable strips non [a-z0-9] (ü). Index still 1:1. Not the miss cause for 阈值 (yu|zhi window exists at 阈之).
sideNotes.polyphoneFalsePositiveInCsv: syllable_alignment.csv charPinyinMatchesStream=false for 调/重/校 when isolated pinyin ≠ contextual run pinyin.
